passages.title: Letter: Why I want to move
passages.text:
Dear Sir or Madam[/,]

I am writing to apply for permanent residence in Canada[./.] I have worked as a logistics manager in Lagos for seven years[,/,] and I hold a degree in engineering[;/.] My wife and I have two children[/,] and we hope to give them a safe[/,] stable life[/.] Canada offers strong schools[,/,] good healthcare[/,] and real opportunity[./.]

Why do you think I am a good candidate[./?] I speak English fluently[,/,] I have saved enough money[/,] and I am ready to work hard[/.] I look forward to hearing from you[!/.]

Yours faithfully[/,]
Adaeze Okafor

passages.title: Essay: My study plan
passages.text:
Studying abroad is expensive[;/,] but it can change a person's future[./.] Before I apply[/,] I must pass the language test[/,] get my degree assessed[/,] and prove that I have enough funds[./.]

Many students ask[:/:] is it worth the cost[./?] In my view[/,] the answer is yes[,/.] However[/,] students must plan carefully[./.] They should compare schools[,/,] save early[/,] and avoid agents who promise easy visas[;/.] Honest preparation is the only reliable route[!/.]

passages.title: Email: Job search update
passages.text:
Hello Mr[./.] Kovacs[/,]

Thank you for meeting me yesterday[./.] I enjoyed learning about your warehouse operations[,/,] your delivery routes[/,] and your plans for growth[./.] Do you need more information from me[./?]

I can send my references[,/,] my certificates[/,] and my work history by Friday[/.] If a different time suits you better[/,] please let me know[!/.] I appreciate your time[;/,] and I hope to speak again soon[./.]

Best regards[/,]
Tunde Bello
